verses.text_en: Wherever this decree was received, the people kept up a revelry of joy and shouting, as if their long-pent-up, hardened hatred would now show itself openly.
verses.text_hr: Gdje god je ta odredba stigla, narod je priređivao slavlja uz radosne povike, kao da će se sada napokon otvoreno pokazati njihova dugo zatomljivana i okorjela mržnja.

verses.text_en: The Jews suffered great throes of sorrow and wept much, while their hearts, all things around being lamentable, were set on fire as they bewailed the sudden destruction which was decreed against them.
verses.text_hr: Židove je obuzela silna bol i mnogo su plakali. Dok je sve oko njih bilo ispunjeno tugom, srca su im gorjela dok su oplakivali iznenadno uništenje na koje su bili osuđeni.

verses.text_en: What home, or city, or any inhabited place, or what streets were there, which their condition didn’t fill with wailing and lamentation?
verses.text_hr: Je li uopće bilo doma, grada, naseljena mjesta ili ulice koje njihova sudbina nije ispunila jaukom i naricanjem?

verses.text_en: They were sent out unanimously by the generals in various cities, with such stern and pitiless feeling that the exceptional nature of the infliction moved even some of their enemies. These, influenced by sentiments of common humanity, and reflecting upon the uncertain issue of life, shed tears at their miserable expulsion.
verses.text_hr: Zapovjednici u različitim gradovima jednodušno su ih protjerivali s takvom strogošću i bez samilosti da je iznimna okrutnost kazne ganula čak i neke njihove neprijatelje. Potaknuti zajedničkom ljudskošću i svjesni neizvjesnosti života, i oni su lili suze nad njihovim bijednim progonstvom.

verses.text_en: A multitude of aged hoary-haired old men were driven along with halting bending feet, urged onward by the impulse of a violent, shameless force to quick speed.
verses.text_hr: Mnoštvo sijedih staraca tjerali su naprijed; njihove klecave i pogrbljene noge silili su da pod pritiskom nasilne i bestidne sile ubrzaju korak.

verses.text_en: Girls who had entered the bridal chamber quite lately, to enjoy the partnership of marriage, exchanged pleasure for misery; and with dust scattered upon their myrrh-anointed heads, were hurried along unveiled; and, in the midst of outlandish insults, set up with one accord a lamentable cry instead of the marriage hymn.
verses.text_hr: Djevojke koje su tek nedavno ušle u svadbenu odaju da bi uživale u bračnom zajedništvu zamijenile su radost bijedom. Glave namazane smirnom posule su prašinom, a njih su žurno vodili bez velova; usred nečuvenih poruga jednoglasno su dizale bolan jauk umjesto svadbene pjesme.

verses.text_en: Bound and exposed to public gaze, they were hurried violently on board ship.
verses.text_hr: Svezane i izložene javnim pogledima, nasilno su ih ukrcavali na brodove.

verses.text_en: The husbands of these, in the prime of their youthful vigor, instead of crowns, wore ropes round their necks. Instead of feasting and youthful celebration, they spent the rest of their nuptial days in wailing, and saw only the grave at hand.
verses.text_hr: Njihovi muževi, u cvijetu mladenačke snage, oko vrata su umjesto vijenaca nosili konopce. Umjesto gozbe i mladenačkog slavlja, preostale su svadbene dane provodili u naricanju, gledajući pred sobom jedino skori grob.

verses.text_en: They were dragged along by unyielding chains, like wild animals. Of these, some had their necks thrust into the benches of the rowers, while the feet of others were enclosed in hard fetters.
verses.text_hr: Vukli su ih u čvrstim lancima poput divljih životinja. Nekima su vratove privezali uz veslačke klupe, a drugima noge stegnuli teškim okovima.

verses.text_en: The planks of the deck above them blocked out the light and shut out the day on every side, so that they might be treated like traitors during the whole voyage.
verses.text_hr: Daske palube nad njima zaklanjale su svjetlo i sa svih strana priječile dan, kako bi ih cijelo putovanje držali poput izdajnika.

verses.text_en: They were carried like this in this vessel, and at the end of it arrived at Schedia. The king had ordered them to be cast into the vast hippodrome, which was built in front of the city. This place was well adapted by its situation to expose them to the gaze of all comers into the city, and of those who went from the city into the country. Thus they could hold no communication with his forces. They weren’t deemed worthy of any civilized accommodation.
verses.text_hr: Tako su ih prevezli brodovima i na kraju stigli u Shediju. Kralj je zapovjedio da ih bace u golemi hipodrom sagrađen ispred grada. Njegov je položaj bio prikladan da ih izloži pogledu svih koji ulaze u grad i onih koji iz grada odlaze na selo. Ondje nisu mogli održavati vezu s njegovim snagama niti ih se smatralo dostojnima ikakva čovječnog smještaja.

verses.text_en: When this was done, the king, hearing that their kindred in the city often went out and lamented the melancholy distress of these victims,
verses.text_hr: Kad je to učinjeno, kralj je doznao da njihovi rođaci iz grada često izlaze i oplakuju žalosnu nevolju tih stradalnika.

verses.text_en: was full of rage, and commanded that they should be carefully subjected to the same—and not one bit milder—treatment.
verses.text_hr: Razbjesnio se i zapovjedio da i njih brižno podvrgnu posve istom, nimalo blažem postupanju.

verses.text_en: The whole nation was now to be registered. Every individual was to be specified by name, not for that hard servitude of labor which we have a little before mentioned, but that he might expose them to the before-mentioned tortures; and finally, in the short space of a day, might exterminate them by his cruelties.
verses.text_hr: Sada je trebalo popisati čitav narod i svakoga pojedinca navesti po imenu — ne radi teškoga ropskog rada koji smo malo prije spomenuli, nego zato da ih izloži već navedenim mukama i naposljetku ih u jednom jedinom danu istrijebi svojim okrutnostima.

verses.text_en: The registering of these men was carried on cruelly, zealously, assiduously, from the rising of the sun to its going down, and was not brought to an end in forty days.
verses.text_hr: Popisivanje tih ljudi obavljalo se okrutno, revno i neumorno, od izlaska do zalaska sunca, pa ni nakon četrdeset dana nije bilo dovršeno.

verses.text_en: The king was filled with great and constant joy, and celebrated banquets before the temple idols. His erring heart, far from the truth, and his profane mouth gave glory to idols, deaf and incapable of speaking or aiding, and uttered unworthy speech against the Greatest God.
verses.text_hr: Kralj je bio ispunjen neprestanom velikom radošću i priređivao gozbe pred hramskim idolima. Njegovo zabludjelo srce, daleko od istine, i njegova bezbožna usta slavili su idole koji su gluhi i ne mogu ni govoriti ni pomoći, a protiv Svevišnjega Boga izgovarali su nedostojne riječi.

verses.text_en: At the end of the above-mentioned interval of time, the registrars brought word to the king that the multitude of the Jews was too great for registration,
verses.text_hr: Po isteku spomenutoga vremena popisivači su obavijestili kralja da je mnoštvo Židova preveliko da bi ih se moglo popisati.

verses.text_en: inasmuch as there were many still left in the land, of whom some were in inhabited houses, and others were scattered about in various places, so that all the commanders in Egypt were insufficient for the work.
verses.text_hr: Mnogi su još ostali u zemlji: jedni u nastanjenim kućama, drugi raspršeni po različitim mjestima, pa ni svi zapovjednici u Egiptu nisu bili dovoljni za taj posao.

verses.text_en: The king threatened them, and charged them with taking bribes, in order to contrive the escape of the Jews, but was clearly convinced of the truth of what had been said.
verses.text_hr: Kralj im je zaprijetio i optužio ih da primaju mito kako bi Židovima omogućili bijeg, ali se na kraju jasno uvjerio da govore istinu.

verses.text_en: They said, and proved, that paper and pens had failed them for the carrying out of their purpose.
verses.text_hr: Rekli su i dokazali da im je za dovršenje nauma ponestalo papira i pisaljki.

verses.text_en: Now this was an active interference of the unconquerable Providence which assisted the Jews from heaven.
verses.text_hr: U tome se očitovao djelotvoran zahvat nepobjedive Providnosti koja je s neba pomagala Židovima.
